autonomy_tiers.name: advisory_only
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may analyze or propose, but may not change tracked or external state.

autonomy_tiers.name: draft_and_prepare
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may prepare drafts or task records, but not finalize sensitive outcomes without acceptance.

autonomy_tiers.name: internal_execution
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may change tracked repo files and private runtime within an approved task.

autonomy_tiers.name: external_action_with_review
autonomy_tiers.description: AI may prepare external actions, but execution requires review or approval.

autonomy_tiers.name: human_only
autonomy_tiers.description: Only a human may approve or perform this action.

risk_tiers.description: Internal documentation, research, analysis, and low-cost reversible work.
Changes to shared truth, workflows, scripts, or multi-file coordination with reversible impact.
External writes, spend, deployments, legal/public commitments, destructive or irreversible actions.

human_only_actions: any public statement or publication on behalf of the company
any unbudgeted spend or money movement
any destructive delete of tracked source-of-truth files
any grant of new external system write access
governor_review_required_for: all changes to control-plane policy or workflow files
all tasks with autonomy tier A3
all tasks that touch more than one system of record
all weekly metric threshold breaches that could change autonomy or approvals

required_actions: assign an owner to every breached threshold or explicitly defer it
carry forward policy or workflow changes through tracked source-of-truth files
do not increase autonomy from anecdote alone

minimum_checks_for_repeated_work: at least one lightweight review or eval signal before expanding autonomy
control_plane_change_requires: relevant local tests when scripts or contracts change
python3 scripts/hq_control_plane.py sync after queue changes

memory_hygiene.shared_truth_rule: Shared Markdown holds accepted company truth; private runtime holds continuity and operating exhaust.
rules: Do not copy raw runtime notes into shared truth without acceptance.
Do not let `.hq/` become a second project registry.
Use weekly review to identify stale runtime habits before adding more memory infrastructure.

required_preflight: validate the control plane before accepting schema or policy changes
probe a local CLI before routing a workflow through it
generate weekly metrics from telemetry, not chat reconstruction
drift_signals: repeated policy exceptions without a decision update
documentation lag remaining above threshold for more than one review
eval coverage staying below threshold on repeated work

metric_thresholds.action: Tighten task contracts and acceptance checks before expanding autonomy.
Review routing, task shaping, and approval thresholds.
Reduce queue ambiguity or policy bottlenecks before increasing workload.
Reduce closeout scope or rebalance documentation capacity.
Review whether policy, acceptance checks, or rollback notes are too weak.
Backfill missing telemetry or lower autonomy until coverage is reliable.
Add lightweight review or eval signals before repeating the same workflow more autonomously.

kill_switches: missing telemetry for a high-risk action
rework_or_rollback_rate exceeds the accepted weekly threshold
telemetry_coverage_rate stays below threshold for two weekly reviews in a row
documentation_rule: Documentation may sync shared truth only after acceptance or explicit CEO override.
board_rule: Render `02 Planning/Task Board.md` from `05 AI Control Plane/active-work.json` after material queue changes.
